response.overview: In the mountains of Lesotho KABELO a shepherd determined to escape the shepherd life meets MASTER a fugitive from South Africa hiding out in the village. Master cons Kabelo promising that he will take him to Johannesburg and mentor him in his many businesses. A desperate companionship forms and we realise that these are just two people from different walks of life both seeking freedom. The film invites you to journey through the realms of identity, where a shepherd's humble existence intertwines with the fleeting shadows of a fugitive. Each frame captures the essence of longing and belonging, painting a vivid portrait of two souls searching for their place in a world that often feels too vast and unwelcoming.
response.tagline: A fugitive hiding out in the Lesotho mountains befriends a shepherd who is equally desperate to escape, but will his lies lead him to freedom?
response.title: KABELO
